summary.text: Benjamin Baroody is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Baroody is a former state representative who left the House in December 2024 after losing his Hillsborough 39 seat, and he is a realtor.

paragraphs.text: Benjamin Baroody was born in Manchester, New Hampshire, and graduated from Manchester Central High School in 1964.
His career experience includes working as a realtor.
Ballotpedia lists Baroody as a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 1992 to 2012, representing Hillsborough 13, and from 2014 to 2024.
His most recent service, representing Hillsborough 39, began on December 7, 2022, and ended on December 4, 2024, after he lost the 2024 general election for that district.
During the 2011-2012 session Baroody served on the Finance Committee, and at the start of the 2017 session he served on the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee.
